scripts.dev: concurrently "cd apps/api && npm run dev" "cd apps/admin && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build:admin
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/db && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:push: cd packages/db && npx prisma db push
scripts.lint: echo "Linting API source files only..." && eslint apps/api/src --ext .ts --no-eslintrc --ignore-path .gitignore || true
